note: Publisher register with historical verification dates preserved. Official links define exchange fields; project-defined strategies, suggestions and computed metrics are separately labelled. data/snapshot.json is a normalized point-in-time capture, not the original raw HTTP bodies. Published settlement-source strings are reproduced as API data, not independently authenticated authorities or proven causes. Missing confirmed values stay blank and are flagged.

docs.title: Test In The Demo Environment
docs.confirms: Demo environment endpoints (REST https://external-api.demo.kalshi.co/trade-api/v2, also supported https://demo-api.kalshi.co/trade-api/v2; WebSocket wss://external-api-ws.demo.kalshi.co/trade-api/ws/v2 and wss://demo-api.kalshi.co/trade-api/ws/v2); demo uses mock funds; credentials are not shared with production; demo prices and behaviour may not reflect real markets.
docs.verification: Read in full on 2026-11-20. The endpoint table matches the brief exactly.

docs.title: API Environments and Endpoints
docs.confirms: REST and WebSocket base URLs for demo and production; credentials are not shared between environments; the signature covers the full request path from the API root without query parameters.

docs.title: Quick Start: Market Data
docs.confirms: Public market-data endpoints (series, events, markets, orderbook) require no authentication; market-data responses are cached for a short time so prices, sizes and status can lag the exchange by several seconds.

docs.title: Quick Start: Authenticated Requests
docs.confirms: Headers KALSHI-ACCESS-KEY, KALSHI-ACCESS-TIMESTAMP (ms) and KALSHI-ACCESS-SIGNATURE; signature = base64 of sign(timestamp + METHOD + path-without-query) using RSA-PSS/SHA-256 (salt length = digest length) or Ed25519; common errors 401, header_timestamp_expired, insufficient_scope.
docs.verification: Read in full on 2026-11-20. The signing scheme implemented in assets/app.js follows it exactly.

docs.title: API Keys
docs.confirms: Where demo API keys are created, the key scopes and the authentication-error codes.
docs.verification: Linked from the authentication guide and from demo_env on 2026-11-20. Not quoted on this site - no claim here depends on it.

docs.title: Market Settlement
docs.confirms: On a YES outcome YES holders receive $1.00 per contract; on a NO outcome NO holders receive $1.00 per contract; only net positions are settled; settlement timing varies by market type; settlement fees are zero for simple yes/no determinations.
docs.verification: Read in full on 2026-11-20. This is the rule the simulated portfolio settles against.

docs.title: Market Lifecycle
docs.confirms: Statuses initialized, active, inactive, closed, determined, disputed, amended, finalized; result is yes, no or scalar; settlement_ts is populated once a market reaches finalized; the status= filter maps open->active, closed->any past close_time not yet finalized, settled->finalized.
docs.verification: Read in full on 2026-11-20. Drives the resolution tracker.

docs.title: Rate Limits and Tiers
docs.confirms: Token-bucket read/write budgets; most requests cost 10 tokens; unauthenticated public requests are subject to separate limits and callers should back off on 429.

docs.title: Get Series List
docs.confirms: Query parameters category, tags, include_product_metadata, include_volume and min_updated_ts. There is no limit parameter, so a category query returns every series in that category.
docs.verification: Read on 2026-11-20. Confirmed live: the Elections category query returned 2709 series with limit=100 in the URL, i.e. the limit was ignored.

docs.title: Get Markets
docs.confirms: Filters series_ticker, event_ticker, tickers, status, min/max timestamp filters and cursor paging; when tickers is the only filter every matching market is returned in one response; filtered listings can lag the exchange.
docs.verification: Read on 2026-11-20 and confirmed live (GET /markets?tickers=... returns the requested tickers in one call).

docs.title: Get Market
docs.confirms: Market payload fields and their meaning: last_price_dollars, yes_bid_dollars, yes_ask_dollars, no_bid_dollars, no_ask_dollars, yes_bid_size_fp, yes_ask_size_fp, volume_fp, volume_24h_fp, open_interest_fp, notional_value_dollars (total value of a single contract at settlement), result (yes|no|scalar|''), status, rules_primary, settlement_ts.
docs.verification: Read on 2026-11-20 and confirmed against a live demo market payload.

docs.title: Get Market Orderbook
docs.confirms: GET /markets/{ticker}/orderbook?depth= returns orderbook_fp.yes_dollars and orderbook_fp.no_dollars, each an array of [price_dollars, contract_count_fp] pairs; depth is 0-100 and 0 returns all levels.

docs.title: Get Market Candlesticks
docs.confirms: GET /series/{series_ticker}/markets/{ticker}/candlesticks with start_ts, end_ts (seconds) and period_interval of 1, 60 or 1440 minutes; at most 5000 periods per request.
docs.verification: Read on 2026-11-20. The path includes the series ticker - the shorter /markets/{ticker}/candlesticks form is not documented.

docs.title: Get Events
docs.confirms: Event listing endpoint used with series_ticker, status and with_nested_markets to capture resolved events and their market-level results.
docs.verification: Called live against the demo host; the captured responses are stored in data/snapshot.json under topics.*.settled_events with their exact request URLs.

docs.title: Create Order (V2)
docs.confirms: POST /portfolio/events/orders with body {ticker, client_order_id, side, count, price, time_in_force, self_trade_prevention_type, post_only, cancel_order_on_pause, reduce_only, subaccount, exchange_index}; response {order_id, client_order_id, fill_count, remaining_count, ts_ms}.
docs.verification: Read on 2026-11-20. No real order was placed from this site - see the Flagged page.

docs.title: WebSocket Connection
docs.confirms: The WebSocket endpoint requires API-key authentication during the handshake even for public market-data channels; channels include ticker, orderbook_delta, trade and market_lifecycle_v2.
docs.verification: Read on 2026-11-20. This is why the live alert feed on this site polls REST instead of streaming over WebSocket.
